name: Tattoo
overview: Scripture instructs believers to honor God with their bodies, as seen in Leviticus 19:28, which forbids making cuttings or marks on the flesh, emphasizing God's ownership over our bodies. Romans 1:24 further warns against dishonoring the body through sinful desires, underscoring the need for purity and respect for the physical temple God has given. James 4:14 reminds us of the fleeting nature of life, encouraging a perspective that values eternal significance over temporary or external alterations such as tattoos.
